title: carlina gummifera
intro: Carlina gummifera, commonly known as Carline Thistle, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve joint pain, and support the immune system. The health benefits of Carlina gummifera are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are primarily due to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones like carlinoside and carlignan. The plant's bioactive compounds also exhibit immunomodulatory and hepatoprotective effects, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
